payload.objective: Implement the accepted restoration plan in the existing skill, including deterministic contracts, integrated YAML policy, JSONL diagnostics, tests and fresh failing demo fixture.
instructions: Manager accepts reports/restoration/plan.json revision1 unchanged, SHA256 4ee180ac24876633d62198fc71488ea82df291dcb25e83a657f900329e87f64b. Read full plan and Owner instructions; follow all original acceptance. You are sole product implementation mutator now; Planner wrote no app code. Activation agent writes only separate evidence/runtime.

Build the installable skill first. Put small dependency-free deterministic validator inside its scripts, communication schema/spec and restricted documented YAML role/workflow policy in skill package. Do not build a generic schema framework, supervisor, database, transport adapter or model engine. Preserve actual native TOML keys, update all role instructions and references to require JSON and policy; body SKILL under100 lines. No YAML parsing dependency installation.

Strict JSON parsing must reject duplicate keys at any depth, nonfinite/overflow numeric literals, UTF8 errors/lone surrogate strings, unexpected fields, wrong types/bools as int, unsupported protocol/version, invalid roles/routes, empty/bounded identities, timestamps, oversized/deep data. Implement closed type-specific payload validation for all8 Owner vocabulary purposes. Provide concise errors. Owner messages need real provenance where external context is supplied; do not claim sender authentication from content.

Provide optional ordered-context checks for predecessor/identity/plan/task/revision/attempt/candidate/evidence association and frozen acceptance refs. Acceptance of final work must require distinct Tester and Reviewer evidence for same candidate, not Worker assertion. External expected-sender/instance or observed bindings must reject origin-role impersonation in controlled boundaries, while explicitly acknowledging native transport remains outside helper authority.

Evidence refs should use artifact_id,path,sha256,kind per published plan. Validate actual files/hashes under explicitly supplied authorized repository root without following traversal/symlinks outside root. Never copy large evidence into messages. Versioned examples must be labeled artificial; actual packets use real current timestamps/IDs/native task paths.

Existing bootstrap messages preceding schema creation are actual immutable history, not magically already validated: bootstrap/REST-M001/M003 have pre-schema payloads, initial activation REST-M004 and preflight may use identity rather than artifact_id. Preserve originals. Published REST-M002 uses desired artifact refs. Ensure strict plan.progress schema supports documented bootstrap fields or disclose which bootstrap records only receive envelope/JSON validation; never weaken final payload rules just to call all bootstrap passing. Actual new demo exchanges after helper exists must be fully validated before/after native dispatch.

YAML source covers roles, Owner authority, evidence, isolation, no OS permission grants, indefinite productive engineering rework, stop identical unproductive failures. Three infrastructure retries and two crash recoveries are instruction-only policy, not new runtime counters. Restricted parser must reject unsupported tags/anchors/aliases/duplicates and clearly document subset. Optional bounded JSONL validator/export events no secrets/private reasoning, not authoritative crash-safe ledger.

Create tiny fresh demo/structured-flow/sum_values.py and tests as frozen plan specifies. Deliberately valid incomplete initial fixture ignores all operands after first so mandatory 2 3 -1 test fails. Do not complete it: separate Tester must observe failure, Manager will send JSON rework to a fresh Worker. No old receipt/CSV modifications. Mark expected initial failure clearly and retain real output.

Run all existing45 checks (8static updated only old no-scripts assertion under current Owner authorization, 11receipt,5independentreceipt,15CSV,6independentCSV) and focused contract tests. Keep intentional oldstarter failure and newdemo initial failure separate; do not count either as passing. Use meaningful adversarial mutations C01-C12. All test fixtures/tempfiles explicitly inside repo and cleaned.

Update README/RELEASE explaining formats, validation commands, installation copies complete skill+native TOMLs. Create compact reports/requirements-traceability.md with original Owner source, implementation, methods, status layers and truthful pending live statuses. Do not update final report/ZIP/commit yet; Manager handles final release after verification.

Return ONLY a bounded version1.0 JSON job.report using your implemented schema, with compact status/candidate/files/findings/error/evidence refs; save complete worker report/logs under reports/restoration/worker. Tell Manager exact helper CLI/API and post-schema packet shapes early, as soon as saved, using JSON report. Save actual job.report file immutable with hash refs. No self-approval, no scope/acceptance changes or approval requests for ordinary work. Stop all mutations after handoff.
